template: There should be an open, unsaved Odoo quotation form in the browser (breadcrumb 'Quotations / New', customer '{{v1}}', one order line for product '{{v3}}'). First re-read the form: confirm the Customer field is set to '{{v1}}' (if not, set it via the autocomplete dropdown), confirm the order line's product is '{{v3}}' chosen from the dropdown, and set the line's Quantity to exactly 3 (re-enter it if needed). Then SAVE the quotation so it gets a real record (a quotation reference like S000xx appears in the breadcrumb and the URL gains an id= parameter). If the save is blocked, look for any red/invalid required field or validation error and fix it, then save again. Do not wait for network idle. After saving, report: (a) the quotation reference/name shown in the breadcrumb, (b) the product name on the order line, (c) the Unit Price shown on that line, (d) the Quantity shown on that line, and (e) the {{v4}} shown in the totals section of the saved quotation.
